_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Service Bulletins
summary: This DID is used by the Government to acknowledge a contractor's or equipment vendor's issuance of new information on maintenance problems and procedures recommended for their equipment.
use_relationship:
This Data will be used by the Government to acknowledge the issuance by the contractor or equipment vendor of new information on maintenance problems and/or procedures recommended to be implemented on the contractor's or vendor's equipment.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The service bulletins shall be presented in the Contractor's format and shall contain the following information:

children.title: Changes that effect equipment operating or maintenance procedures.
Changes to equipment configurations from component parts to full assemblies.
Revision of circuit modules, in Contractor Furnished Equipment (CFE), and the purpose of the change and availability of the circuit module.
children.content: It shall also include any impacts on form-fit of hardware and software.

children.title: Any potential safety hazards not previously identified.
